messages:
Sarah: Heads-up — PR #20482 (db migration + index change) is ready from my side. CI is flaky on mac-e2e but all unit/integration green. Deploy freeze starts 02/15 00:00 UTC. Can we get a short rebase/merge window today?

Jon: can you paste the failing test logs? if it's only mac-e2e we might still land behind a canary. :eyes:

Sarah: logs are noisy but looks like flakey timeout in auth flow. small repro in test harness. I can try a rerun + rebase to main to pull recent infra fixes.

Sarah: snippet I ran locally:```
git fetch origin
git rebase origin/main
# run tests: ./tools/run-e2e --platform mac --filter auth-flow
```

CI Bot: CI status for PR #20482: 4/8 checks passed, 2 running, 2 failed (mac-e2e flaky). Rerun available.

Tanya: @Sarah thanks for the heads-up. I can approve once mac-e2e is green or we have a canary fallback plan. What's the expected window length?

Release Captain: We have a 45-minute pre-freeze slot at 18:15 UTC where we can land low-risk fixes. If you can get green before then we can do a manual canary. Otherwise we hold until after freeze.

Sarah: aiming for that slot. I'll rebase+force-push now and trigger a rerun. tagging @Tanya for approval after green.

Jon: rerunning CI: `/ci rerun 20482 --owners jon,sarah` — kicked off. will monitor flakes and try a cross-matrix rerun for mac.

CI Bot: Rerun started: mac-e2e (attempt 3). ETA ~12 minutes.

Jon: if mac still flakes, we can consider landing behind a canary with a circuit-breaker: route 5% traffic for 30m, monitor errors & latency. ops can roll back fast. Thoughts @Release Captain?

Release Captain: canary sounds reasonable for this db change, but only if we have a rollback plan and monitoring alarms set. ops on standby during the 18:15 slot?

Tanya: i'm fine approving for a canary if CI is stable-ish (no red unit tests) and we document rollback steps in the PR description. :+1:

Sarah: noted. I'll update PR with canary plan + rollback runbook (DB index backout & table checksum check). pushing now.

CI Bot: All checks green for PR #20482 (after rerun). Mac e2e passed on attempt 3.

Tanya: approving now. good job on triage, @Sarah.

Sarah: thanks everyone — landing during 18:15 UTC slot and will post status here. :thumbsup:

Jon: I'll watch the CI and the canary metrics during rollout. ping me if anything weird.

Release Captain: confirmed for 18:15 UTC. ops team alerted. leaving a 1-hr hold after canary to confirm stability.

Sarah: landed and canary started. routing 5% traffic, monitoring dashboards: all green so far. will update with 30m snapshot.

CI Bot: Deploy event: PR #20482 -> deployed canary at 18:17 UTC (5% traffic).

Sarah: 30m snapshot — latency and error rate within baseline. promoting to full rollout in 5m.

Release Captain: promoting now. good work team. closing thread after 1hr hold. :tada:
